## Supplementary Materials


```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1000
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(data.table)

######### Data Preparation #########
# data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/santi-rios/China-Chemical-Rise/refs/heads/main/data/merged_figure1.csv"
data_url <- "./data/fig_supplements_filtered.csv"

df <- fread(data_url) %>% 
  mutate(Country = as.factor(Country), source = as.factor(source)) %>%
  filter(source != c("FigurS-2", "FigureS-4_organoMetallicKW", "FigureS-5", "FigureS-6", "FigureS-7a_b"))

######### Custom Labels #########
figure_labels <- list(
  "FigureS-2" = list(y_title = "% of GDP invested in research", map_title = "Research and development expenditure for China and the US"), 

  "FigureS-3" = list(y_title = "General Gov. Debt (% of GDP)", map_title = "Govermment debt as % of GDP"), 

  "FigureS-4_organicKW" = list(y_title = "Frequency", map_title = "Words in keywords organic"),

  "FigureS-4_organoMetallicKW" = list(y_title = "Frequency", map_title = "Words in keywords organometallic"),

  "FigureS-5" = list(y_title = "% of substances contributed by e/country", map_title = "Countries participation in chemical space growth"), 

  "FigureS-6" = list(y_title = "% of substances contributed by e/collab.", map_title = "Top 10 international collaborations for expanding the organic chemical space"), 

  "FigureS-7a_b" = list(y_title = "% of organometallic chemical space", map_title = "Organometallic CS spanned by elements"), 

  "FigureS-7a_e" = list(y_title = "% of rare-earth chemical space", map_title = "REE CS spanned by elements")

)

######### APP #########
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly", primary = "#2c3e50", secondary = "#18bc9c"),
  
  # Navbar
  div(
    class = "navbar navbar-static-top primary bg-primary",
    div("China's rise in the chemical space and the decline of US influence, Supplementary Figures", class = "container-fluid")
  ),
  
  # Control Panel
  card(
    card_header("Select Figure and Year", class = "bg-primary text-light"),
    card_body(
      selectInput("facet", "Select figure:",
                  choices = levels(df$source),
                  selected = "FigureS-2",
                  width = "100%"),
      
      sliderInput("year", "Year",
                  min = min(df$Year) + 1,
                  max = max(df$Year) - 1,
                  value = max(df$Year) - 1,
                  step = 1,
                  # animate = animationOptions(interval = 500, loop = FALSE),
                  animate = FALSE,
                  width = "100%"),
      
      uiOutput("figure_description")
    )
  ),
  
  # Visualization Panel
  card(
    full_screen = TRUE,
    card_header("Interactive Visualizations", class = "bg-primary text-light"),
    card_body(
      plotlyOutput("emissionsPlot", height = "50vh"),
      br(),
      plotlyOutput("worldMap", height = "40vh")
    )
  ),
  
  # Footer
  div(
    class = "footer navbar navbar-static-bottom bg-light",
    style = "margin-bottom: 20px;",
    div(
      class = "container-fluid",
      "Data source: Bermudez-Montana, Garcia-Chung, et al, 2025 - ",
      a("ChemRxiv Publication", href = "https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv-2025-d2zc8",
        style = "color: #18bc9c;")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  ######### Reactive Values #########
  # Initialize all countries as selected by default
  selected_countries <- reactiveVal(levels(df$Country))
  
  ######### Observers #########
  
  # Update selected countries when facet changes
  observeEvent(input$facet, {
    countries <- df[source == input$facet, unique(Country)]
    selected_countries(countries)
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE)
  
  # Handle plotly legend clicks for emissionsPlot
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_legendclick", source = "emissions"), {
    click <- event_data("plotly_legendclick", source = "emissions")
    current <- selected_countries()
    
    if (!is.null(click$name)) {
      if (click$name %in% current) {
        updated <- setdiff(current, click$name)
      } else {
        updated <- c(current, click$name)
      }
      # Update the reactive selected_countries
      selected_countries(updated)
    }
  })
  
  # Reactive axis labels
  axis_labels <- reactive({
    figure_labels[[input$facet]] %||% list(y_title = "Value", map_title = "Value")
  })
  
  # Filtered data based on selected countries and facet
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$facet, selected_countries())
    df[source == input$facet & Country %in% selected_countries()]
  })
  
  ######### UI Outputs #########
  
  # Figure description
  output$figure_description <- renderUI({
    desc_text <- switch(input$facet,
      "FigureS-2" = "Research and development expenditure for China and the US",
      "FigureS-3" = "General Gov. Debt (% of GDP)", map_title = "Govermment debt as % of GDP",
      "FigureS-4_organicKW" = "Words in keywords organic",
      "FigureS-4_organoMetallicKW" = "Words in keywords organometallic",
      "FigureS-5" = "Countries participation in chemical space growth",
      "FigureS-6" = "Top 10 international collaborations for expanding the organic chemical space",
      "FigureS-7a_b" = "Organometallic CS spanned by elements",
      "FigureS-7a_e" = "REE CS spanned by elements",
      paste("Displaying:", input$facet)
    )
    
    div(class = "callout",
        h5(desc_text),
        if(input$facet == "FigureS-1") withMathJax(helpText("$$C_{i,t} = \\frac{1}{n_t} \\sum_s \\frac{n_{i,s,t}}{n_{a,s,t}}$$"))
    )
  })
  
  ######### Emissions Plot #########
  
  output$emissionsPlot <- renderPlotly({
    req(filtered_data(), input$year)
    
    plot_data <- filtered_data()[Year <= input$year]
    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
    
    # Create the line plot
    fig <- plot_ly(
      plot_data, 
      x = ~Year, 
      y = ~Value, 
      color = ~Country,
      colors = "Set1",
      type = 'scatter', 
      mode = 'lines+markers', 
      line = list(width = 2),
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      text = ~paste0("<b>", Country, "</b><br>",
                     axis_labels()$y_title, ": ", round(Value, 2),
                     "<br>Year: ", Year),
      source = "emissions",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) 
    
    # Add annotations with country names at the end of each line
    final_data <- plot_data %>% 
      group_by(Country) %>% 
      filter(Year == max(Year)) %>% 
      ungroup()
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(final_data)) {
      fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
        x = final_data$Year[i],
        y = final_data$Value[i],
        text = final_data$Country[i],
        xref = "x",
        yref = "y",
        xanchor = 'left',
        yanchor = 'middle',
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        xshift = 10
      )
    }
    
    fig <- fig %>% layout(
      title = paste("Temporal Analysis -", input$facet),
      xaxis = list(title = "Year", gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"),
      yaxis = list(title = axis_labels()$y_title, gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"),
      hovermode = "closest",
      plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
      legend = list(orientation = 'h', y = -0.2, itemclick = "toggle", itemdoubleclick = FALSE),
      margin = list(r = 40)
    ) 
    
    if (input$facet == "Figure1-d") {
      fig <- fig %>% 
        add_annotations(x = 2020, y = 10, text = "COVID-19", showarrow = FALSE) %>%
        add_annotations(x = 2007, y = 15, text = "Global Financial Crisis", showarrow = FALSE)
    }
    
    return(fig)
  })
  
  ######### World Map #########
  
  output$worldMap <- renderPlotly({
    req(filtered_data(), input$year)
    
    map_data <- filtered_data()[Year == input$year]
    if (nrow(map_data) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
    
    plot_geo(map_data, height = 300) %>%
      add_trace(
        z = ~Value,
        color = ~Value,
        colors = "Blues",
        locations = ~iso3c,
        text = ~paste0("<b>", Country, "</b><br>",
                      axis_labels()$map_title, ": ", round(Value, 2)),
        hoverinfo = "text",
        marker = list(line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
        source = "map"
      ) %>%
      colorbar(title = axis_labels()$map_title, 
               orientation = 'h', y = -0.1) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste("Global Distribution -", input$facet, "(", input$year, ")"),
        geo = list(
          showframe = FALSE,
          showcoastlines = TRUE,
          projection = list(type = "natural earth"),
          bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
          landcolor = "#f8f9fa"
        ),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
